checked.note: verified in a running system - human live check 2026-08-02 (maintainer): app started and exercised, no findings. Both legs are additionally e2e-verified (scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs interaction, transpiled backend + real browser): with the Switch off the liveChange round-trip fills GET_VALUE while model.getProperty() stays behind, and after flipping it the model follows. Restated 2026-08-23: the e2e half of that is narrower than it reads. The module asserts the PRE-flip text in the second Text after the flip, and clicking the Switch blurs the TextArea, which fires change and writes the model regardless of valueLiveUpdate - so that assertion passes even if the flip did nothing. The off-leg is genuinely covered; the model-follows leg rests on the human live check alone. Asserting the POST-flip text would close it.

deviations.what: the sample's whole point is the difference between the control's own value and the model property while valueLiveUpdate is off, so the getValue Text must NOT be bound to the same field as the TextArea. The port keeps them apart the same way: liveChange carries ${$parameters>/value} into the backend, which writes it to the separate field GET_VALUE - the second Text stays bound to the TextArea's own model field, which only updates when valueLiveUpdate is on (or on blur).

behavioural limit of the liveChange round-trip, measured 2026-08-02 in the e2e harness: abap2UI5 serializes round-trips, and until 2026-09-19 a keystroke typed while one was in flight was DROPPED, not queued - typing abc with no delay left GET_VALUE at a (the value of the last COMPLETED round-trip), while the TextArea itself held abc; the e2e interaction therefore typed with a delay. CLOSED 2026-09-19: the wire carries s_ctrl-check_queue_last (abap2UI5 #2739, in the pin since #211), which keeps the LAST event fired during a flight and dispatches it once the response has landed - one round-trip at a time, order kept, the backend ends on the TextArea's current value. Intermediate values can still be skipped under fast typing (the original updates its Text client-side on every keystroke); the last one is not lost, and the interaction module types with no delay.
